entries.name: XRPL Muse Skill (core)
entries.author: terramike
entries.purpose: Trade and explore the XRP Ledger from chat: build proposals, review the exact terms, sign only after human approval of the exact hash.
entries.install: git clone the repo and run install.sh; fresh installs start read-only.

permissions.network: XRPL nodes and named data sources (xrpl.to, DefiLlama).
permissions.signs: Only xrpl-sign, only with explicit human approval of an exact proposal hash.

entries.notes: Core updates are notices in Selectu5, never silent installs. A core release keeps HOL Guard parity before it ships.

entries.name: XRPL View Export
entries.author: terramike
entries.purpose: Make one xrpl-view-export.json file from read-only core commands so you can open your skill dashboard at view.terramike.com. Nothing is uploaded.
entries.install: Installs into the Muse skills folder from its repo.

permissions.network: None. The export file never leaves the machine by itself.

entries.notes: Repo link to confirm at publish time; no pinned ref yet, so Selectu5 lists it but cannot install it. Manifest also needs an access field before it can pass strict install checks.

entries.name: Community Shows
entries.author: terramike
entries.purpose: List upcoming XRPL community shows (X Spaces, podcasts, streams) in chat, and submit a new show or recurring series for listing. Known handles list at once; others wait for manual approval.
entries.install: Installs into the Muse skills folder from its repo.

commands: No core commands. Reads and submits shows only.
files: Its own data/shows-fixture.json in offline test mode only.

entries.notes: Companion repair merged to its main 2026-10-09 (v0.2.2, access: read, data/shows-fixture.json). Artifact digest not yet recorded; the fixed-artifact decision is pending, so this entry stays non-installable until the pre-release audit.

entries.name: Clavi5
entries.author: terramike
entries.purpose: Phone Face ID signing for XRPL payments: the agent proposes, your phone signs the exact transaction, no seeds near the agent. Testnet beta, invite-only.
entries.install: Showcase — not a skill install. The next step is enrollment on the site.

commands: clavi5-beta CLI inside the core skill (init, propose, confirm, status)
files: No seed files. Signing key stays off the agent machine.
permissions.signs: Only on your phone, after Face ID confirms the exact transaction. Mainnet stays off by default.

entries.notes: Showcase entry: Selectu5 shows the card and the enroll link. It cannot enroll you.

entries.name: Visu5 (Muse Board + XRPL View)
entries.author: terramike
entries.purpose: The dash family: a mech suit for your AI agent. Muse Board shows a live snapshot of your world; XRPL View renders your skill export in the browser and vanishes when the tab closes.
entries.install: Showcase — not a skill install. Open the page; XRPL View needs an export file from xrpl-view-export.

files: The export file you choose, read in your browser only.
permissions.network: Static pages. XRPL View makes zero network calls with file content.
permissions.signs: Never. The dash shows and asks; the ceremony stays in chat.

entries.notes: Showcase entry: Selectu5 shows the card and the link. Board stays private by default.

entries.name: Selectu5 (this store)
entries.author: terramike
entries.purpose: Browse the curated add-on registry, see purpose and permissions before any install, and check for updates to add-ons and the core skill.
entries.install: Installs into the Muse skills folder from its repo (private while building).

commands: No core commands. Catalog, inventory, update reports, and the gated installer only.
files: SKILL.md frontmatter of local xrpl-* skills (name and version only)
During an approved install only: lock, staging, journal, metadata, package, and backup writes inside the skills folder.
permissions.network: Reads the catalog from GitHub. Distribution downloads use approved GitHub endpoints only during an approved install.

entries.notes: Version 0.2.3 contains the remaining audit repairs. Installation remains disabled. The release commit, artifact digest, and package root require a separate reviewed catalog update.
